list.title: Symptoms:

list.title: Severity:
list.snippet: The severity of COVID-19 in children varies, with some experiencing mild or asymptomatic infections, while others develop more serious illness requiring hospitalization.

list.title: Risk Factors:
list.snippet: Certain health conditions can increase a child's risk of severe illness, including chronic diseases (heart, lung, nervous system), weakened immune systems, prematurity, obesity, and diabetes, according to the Mayo Clinic.

list.title: Long COVID:
list.snippet: Some children experience long-term effects of COVID-19, known as Long COVID. These can include a range of persistent symptoms.

list.title: Vaccination:
list.snippet: Vaccination is a crucial tool for protecting children against COVID-19 and reducing the risk of severe illness.

list.title: Precautions:
list.snippet: Following recommended safety measures, such as vaccination, masking, and social distancing, can help protect children from COVID-19.
